column1: # lint-pattern-baseline.tsv - adjudicated corpus hits for the baseline patterns.
# then HAND-REVIEWED. Regenerate deliberately and re-review the diff; the diff is
# verdict  TP    = pattern correctly caught a violation that shipped publicly
#          FP    = pattern fired on legitimate technical prose -> NARROW THE PATTERN
#          ALLOW = hit is acceptable; an explicit, argued carve-out
# SHIP GATE: no pattern ships while any row for it is marked FP. This is a count
# on an adjudicated column, not a hit-rate threshold - the denominator never
# enters, so it is immune to the "four counts, four answers" problem.
# Adjudication note, 2026-08-21: every one of the 72 non-prose hits below is a
# true positive. That is not a flattering result - it means review archaeology
# shipped in public PR bodies continuously across #722-#993, and the previous
# literal-phrase denylist caught none of it. The largest single class is the
# "## Pre-Landing Review" section heading, present in 32 merged PRs.
# PROSE_STYLE (em dash) rows are recorded here too. 774 hits across 141 of 161
# PRs is not the pattern being too broad; it is a pervasive habit. See the
# em-dash note in scripts/lint-patterns.sh before changing it.
